title: Git-backed Artifact Ledger & Sync
summary: Wave 1 defines the local Git provider plus a storage-neutral artifact operations API, then proves convention-first bootstrap, API-mediated canonical mutations, compatibility, snapshots, locking, environment coverage, and authority cutover. Later waves add isolated change workspaces, API-owned synchronization, policy provenance, attention, and campaign integration.

nodes.title: Define artifact-root-v1 and project manifest contract
nodes.summary: Define the local Git provider descriptor: project manifest, repository identity, repository-to-root mapping, resolver responses, diagnostics, path capability, and authority semantics consumed by artifact-operations-v1 and read-only callers.

nodes.title: Define artifact-operations-v1 API contract
nodes.summary: Define the storage-neutral local API contract for opaque revisions, coherent reads, begin-change, validation, expected-revision mutation, promotion, provenance, synchronization, capability reporting, and typed conflict states without making a local path or Git commit the permanent API.

nodes.title: Define application and artifact schema compatibility
nodes.summary: Define manifest and artifact version negotiation, supported upgrade/downgrade behavior, incompatible-app diagnostics, and the boundary between Artifact Sync compatibility checks and plugin-owned launch-policy-v1 validation.

nodes.title: Implement convention-first artifact bootstrap
nodes.summary: From a source checkout, discover or preview-create the artifact-only orphan streamliner-artifacts branch, create or adopt its worktree after explicit confirmation, read the shared manifest, and persist the local repository-to-root mapping.

nodes.title: Provide coherent artifact revision snapshots
nodes.summary: Bind launch and context preparation to one opaque artifact revision so manifest, graph, brief, shared records, and provenance are read coherently; retain the local provider's Git commit as optional provenance and retry or fail explicitly when the revision moves during preparation.

nodes.title: Define local locking and concurrent-writer behavior
nodes.summary: Serialize Streamliner-owned local artifact writes and sentry operations, preserve honest behavior for non-Streamliner editors, and define how remote concurrent writers become push rejection, divergence, or conflict attention rather than false local coordination.

nodes.title: Implement API-mediated artifact mutations
nodes.summary: Route Streamliner-owned graph/config and canonical artifact writes through artifact-operations-v1 with expected revisions, validation, atomic application, local writer serialization, and provenance; classify direct canonical-worktree edits as external dirty input instead of overwriting them.

nodes.title: Validate off-branch, cloud-agent, and source-link compatibility
nodes.summary: Prove that source checkouts, artifact-only worktrees, cloud-agent environments, design references, local specs, and source links remain resolvable without assuming artifacts and source files share one branch or filesystem root.

nodes.title: Implement migration authority cutover and rollback
nodes.summary: Move an existing source-branch artifact tree to the artifact branch with preview, explicit authority selection, verification, rollback, and removal or archival of the former copy so two locations cannot remain plausibly authoritative.

nodes.title: Artifact root authority gate
nodes.summary: Builder validates artifact-root-v1, artifact-operations-v1, API-mediated canonical writes, orphan-branch bootstrap, schema/app compatibility, coherent snapshot reads, local locking, off-branch environments, migration rollback, and one unambiguous artifact authority before synchronization automation begins.

nodes.title: Implement deterministic sentry classification
nodes.summary: Behind the local API, classify repository, worktree, branch, remote, clean, ahead, behind, external-edit dirty, diverged, unavailable, and error states and persist local health without creating message or runtime files on the artifact branch.

nodes.title: Handle branch protection and artifact history recovery
nodes.summary: Define protected-branch, approval, rejected-push, force-update, deletion, corruption, and history-recovery behavior so automation preserves auditability and can restore an understandable artifact ledger.

nodes.title: Implement safe synchronization automation
nodes.summary: Apply only the accepted mechanical fetch, update, commit, and push operations through the local API with dry-run, attribution, batching, pause, recovery, and explicit external-edit and semantic-conflict stops; sessions do not synchronize the canonical worktree independently.

nodes.title: Add isolated artifact change workspaces
nodes.summary: Let agent sessions begin a change from an expected revision, edit ordinary files in an isolated workspace, validate the change set, and ask the API to promote it under the canonical writer lock; handle stale bases, abandonment, cleanup, and provenance without creating a second authoritative store.

nodes.title: Deterministic sentry safety gate
nodes.summary: Builder accepts API-owned synchronization, the state classifier and operation matrix, isolated change-workspace promotion, attribution, branch protection, history recovery, stale/external/concurrent-writer stops, and the semantic-conflict boundary before unattended synchronization is enabled.

nodes.title: Resolve shared launch-policy-v1 records
nodes.summary: Store and resolve committed launch-policy-v1 instances, defaults, and role references with artifact commit provenance while leaving schema, precedence, compatibility, interpretation, merging, and validation to Plugin Role Skills.

nodes.title: Enforce shared policy trust and approval
nodes.summary: Bind agent-effective shared records to trusted artifact commits, surface pending or blocked policy changes, and prevent silent activation until repository protection or the accepted approval rule is satisfied.

nodes.title: Project artifact sync health in Streamliner
nodes.summary: Expose artifact-root availability, commit, trust, sentry health, pause, conflict, and recovery diagnostics through the local API and dashboard without requiring an attached agent.

nodes.title: Route actionable artifact attention through Telex
nodes.summary: Emit deduplicated actionable events to durable role addresses with project, workstream, commit, path, and conflict pointers while leaving delivery, liveness, acknowledgement, history, and address semantics to Telex and Actor Fabric.

nodes.title: Shared artifact operations gate
nodes.summary: Builder validates trusted shared-record resolution, local sync-health projection, and role-addressed Telex attention before the campaign-wide two-builder scenario.

nodes.title: Run the Shared Project Operations campaign scenario
nodes.summary: With Namra or another cold second builder, exercise plugin installation, fresh artifact bootstrap, UI-launched orchestrator, shared Telex, reboot or station replacement, implementer/reviewer lifecycle traffic, concurrent isolated change workspaces plus a direct external edit, conflict detection, Telex disposition, and API-mediated durable promotion with provenance.

externalDependsOn.label: Plugin Role Skills provides accepted campaign-gate evidence
Telex-backed Actor Fabric provides accepted lifecycle, replacement, and shared-backend evidence

nodes.title: Shared Project Operations campaign integration gate
nodes.summary: Builder accepts the complete cold-second-builder scenario: role context installs, artifact bootstrap is private-knowledge-free, the UI launches and replaces a role-bound orchestrator, lifecycle events flow through shared Telex, conflicts stop safely, and dispositions promote durably with Git and Telex provenance.

checkpoints.title: Artifact root authoritative
checkpoints.summary: artifact-root-v1, artifact-operations-v1, convention-first bootstrap, API-mediated mutation, compatibility, snapshots, locking, off-branch operation, and migration rollback establish one usable artifact authority.

checkpoints.title: Deterministic synchronization safe
checkpoints.summary: The API-owned sentry classifies state, respects branch protection and history recovery, promotes isolated change workspaces, automates only admitted operations, and stops safely for stale, external, ambiguous, or semantic conflicts.

checkpoints.title: Shared artifact operations integrated
checkpoints.summary: Trusted shared policy records, local health projection, and Telex attention operate through imported Plugin Role Skills and Actor Fabric contracts.

checkpoints.title: Campaign integration demonstrated
checkpoints.summary: The cold-second-builder Shared Project Operations scenario has been exercised and accepted as the campaign integration gate.
